findings.message: SKU "DUP-100" appears 2 times in shopify-store-a with different quantities
findings.suggestion: Deduplicate "DUP-100" in shopify-store-a: one SKU should map to exactly one quantity per location.

findings.message: SKU "ORPHAN-A" exists in shopify-store-a but is missing from shopify-store-b
findings.suggestion: Add "ORPHAN-A" to shopify-store-b or archive it in shopify-store-a — it can never be kept in sync as-is.

findings.message: SKU "BC-A" exists in shopify-store-a but is missing from shopify-store-b
findings.suggestion: Add "BC-A" to shopify-store-b or archive it in shopify-store-a — it can never be kept in sync as-is.

findings.message: SKU "ORPHAN-B" exists in shopify-store-b but is missing from shopify-store-a
findings.suggestion: Add "ORPHAN-B" to shopify-store-a or archive it in shopify-store-b — it can never be kept in sync as-is.

findings.message: SKU "BC-B" exists in shopify-store-b but is missing from shopify-store-a
findings.suggestion: Add "BC-B" to shopify-store-a or archive it in shopify-store-b — it can never be kept in sync as-is.

findings.message: "OVER-1" is out of stock in shopify-store-a (0) but shows 8 available in shopify-store-b — you may be selling stock you don't have
findings.suggestion: Push the real quantity from shopify-store-b to shopify-store-a, or pause the listing in shopify-store-a.

findings.message: "BLANK-1" has a BLANK quantity cell in shopify-store-a (not "0") while shopify-store-b tracks a real quantity — an import may read this as 0 and wipe the stock
findings.suggestion: Write an explicit "0" if the item is truly out of stock, or fill in the real quantity. Never leave quantity cells blank before a bulk import.

findings.message: Barcode 9999999 maps to 2 different SKUs across sources ("BC-A" in shopify-store-a vs "BC-B" in shopify-store-b) — the SKU mapping is likely misconfigured
findings.suggestion: These records share one barcode, so they are almost certainly the same product. Align the SKU in all sources, or fix the barcode on the wrong record.

findings.message: SKU differs only by letter case: "ABC-123" (shopify-store-a) vs "abc-123" (shopify-store-b)
findings.suggestion: Unify SKU casing across sources — many sync tools treat SKUs case-sensitively.

findings.message: SKU matches only after removing whitespace/invisible characters: "DEF-456" (shopify-store-a) vs "DEF-456[sp]" (shopify-store-b)
findings.suggestion: Trim leading/trailing whitespace and remove zero-width characters; make the raw SKU identical in both sources.

findings.message: "DUP-100" quantity differs by 4 (31%): 13 in shopify-store-a vs 9 in shopify-store-b
findings.suggestion: Reconcile the count in the source of truth and re-sync; investigate recent orders/restocks that only one side recorded.

findings.message: "DRIFT-1" quantity differs by 8 (8%): 100 in shopify-store-a vs 92 in shopify-store-b
findings.suggestion: Reconcile the count in the source of truth and re-sync; investigate recent orders/restocks that only one side recorded.

findings.message: "CONT-1" in shopify-store-a allows overselling ("continue selling when out of stock") with quantity 0
findings.suggestion: Confirm this oversell setting is intentional, and make sure the other source does not also count this stock.
If these are the same product, configure your sync tool to strip the prefix/suffix, or rename one SKU.

findings.message: Sync health score: 33/100 — 5 exact, 0 minor drift, 4 severe drift, 6 unmatched of 15 SKUs compared
findings.suggestion: Fix severe drift and orphan SKUs first; they are where oversells and lost sales live.

findings.message: "UNTRACKED-1" has inventory tracking OFF in shopify-store-a but is stock-managed in shopify-store-b
findings.suggestion: Enable inventory tracking for "UNTRACKED-1" in shopify-store-a, otherwise its quantity will never decrement and sync will silently drift.
